_comment: "You may discard a YELLOW card. IF YOU DO, draw a card and create a Gold token." The colour was a key the DISCARD effect did not read, so it discarded hand position 0 whatever colour it was -- and effect_discard picked cards[0] with no choice offered at all. The gate on the whole ability was DISCARDED_CARD_POWER_GTE 1, which asks about the discarded card's POWER, a question this card never asks; the real gate is 'if you do', which is whether a yellow card was found and discarded. 'You may' needs no MAY wrapper here: a filtered discard with no matching card discards nothing and the payoff does not fire, and with a match the payoff is pure upside.
